title: Expand the numerator
text: Replace u with $$-x^2$$ in the series for $$\ln\left(1+u\right)$$, which starts $$u-\frac{u^2}{2}$$. So $$\ln\left(1-x^2\right)$$ starts $$-x^2-\frac{x^4}{2}$$.

title: Simplify and take the limit
text: Dividing by $$x^2$$ gives $$-1-\frac{x^2}{2}$$ plus higher powers of $$x$$, which approaches $$-1$$ as $$x$$ approaches $$0$$.
